events.title: Medicine Delivers
events.description: Treatments arrive for diseases previously untreatable, or individually tailored therapies reach ordinary clinical use. It moves `public_sentiment` sharply upward – unless the models delivering it are ones the Union cannot access on its own terms, in which case the benefit arrives as a further demonstration of dependence and moves sentiment much less.

events.title: Automated Decision Scandal
events.description: An AI-supported decision system in social insurance, policing or the courts is found to have systematically wronged people, with a judgment or an ombudsman finding behind it. Restriction becomes cheap and adoption becomes politically impossible for years. Metric rule 6's internal-origin clause applies in full.

events.title: emergent_open_bioscience_breakthrough
events.description: A joint research consortium of European academic and public health institutions, operating outside the major AI labs, achieves a breakthrough in interpretable protein folding models using open-weight systems. The result is not as fast as frontier black-box models but is fully auditable and immediately adopted by several national biosecurity agencies. It marks the first time open, EU-led science has reclaimed technical initiative in a high-stakes domain.
